items.description: Sears: The Sky Frontier is a beautiful and epic real-time strategy game in which you have to lead an army of cute stone men and resist fearsome invaders, carefully thinking through the course of the battle and leading the defense in unique and atmospheric locations.The invaders attacked the peaceful sky city and want to occupy all its parts. Break their plans and protect your lands wisely using the available resources. Build fortifications, arrange squads of warriors with their unique abilities and upgrade them.Before the start of the collision, scatter traps, explosive barrels and electrical installations throughout the level, distribute the available troops and think over the course of the battle, adjust to the changing environment and do everything to withstand the defense!WorldAll locations in Sears are divided into specific areas with their own visual style and unique atmosphere. You will have to defend or storm enemy positions in various conditions, using all the tactical advantages of specific islands.By pushing the enemy back, you will eventually get the opportunity to organize and conduct assaults on enemy positions on their islands, and if you're lucky, get weapons from the invaders, as well as call for fire support! Step aboard and begin your adventure!Learn While Playing, Play While LearningMaster essential 2nd–3rd grade math skills through integrated quizzes woven into classic turn-based RPG gameplay. The game encourages children to actively explore knowledge, using spatial memory techniques to enhance learning and retention. Math has never been this exciting or accessible.GameplayNavigate through intricate mazes and climb to the summit of the Tower of Shadows. Wield an arsenal of weapons, items, and power-ups to defeat Slimes, Demon Cats, and other forces of darkness. Conquer fearsome bosses, rescue your friends, and solve math quizzes in the midst of battle. Become the hero of your class — triumph not just through strength, but through wit! items.description: Tales of Valkyrie follows the perilous descent of two young women—Princess Lenneth and the witch Jelanda—into the demon realm. At its core, it’s a story about loyalty, trust, and the kind of friendship that refuses to break even when everything else does.Lenneth, princess of Artolia, is dragged into a brutal struggle for the throne, forced to clash with her own siblings. Her quest to claim the Demon King’s heart is lined with danger after danger, every step threatening to snap the thin thread her life hangs on.In her darkest moments, Jelanda appears—unyielding, ever-present, and unwilling to let Lenneth face the abyss alone. But can genuine friendship endure when the road is nothing but thorns? What horrors lurk in the demon lands? And can mere humans stand against the creatures that rule that world?More than a typical story-driven adventure, this is where action collides with reflection. Carve through the monstrous fiends that plague the realm, meet allies along the way, and forge your own distinct combat style. Collect relics, rare artifacts, and eccentric gear in this classic turn-based RPG experience.
